metadata.title: What Documentation is Needed for Unclaimed Funds
metadata.author: ohiocommerce
metadata.shortDescription: Ohio Department of Commerce’s Division of Unclaimed Funds Claims Examiner, Supervisor Anitra Davis, answers frequently asked questions about the required documentation that is needed and why it's important to claim your funds.  She discusses everything from social security numbers to what is needed to show proof of address to claim on behalf of a deceased person and the timeline for processing claims. Visit unclaimedfunds.ohio.gov to search and see if you have unclaimed funds today! #divisionunclaimedfunds  #ohiocommerce #ohiounclaimedfunds #unclaimedfunds
